title: 035 S1b: the S1 screen on every early gbb candidate run start (follow-up 1 of report.md)
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era. S1b replaces S1 as the gate to S2; S2 and S3 rules are the parent's, unchanged.

sample.bars: first bar of each run of width_twin._gates (gbb rule + control guards, NO width cut), per pair, entry bar inside the fold test window, quote volume >= 1000 (the simulator's MIN_QV)
sample.note: run starts counted before this commit (no outcome or input read): 17,825 over f00-f07, 1,344-3,142 per fold

outcome: net profit ratio of a trade entered at the next bar's open and exited by the 24 h grace control's exits (paths.replay, as the width-book simulator), without occupancy, wallet or max-open limits
statistic: partial Spearman of input with outcome given bb_width and control p_buy (screen.partial_spearman), pooled and per fold
rule_why: pooled SE ~ 1/sqrt(17825) = 0.0075, so 0.03 is ~4 SE; per-fold SE ~0.018-0.027, so sign stability in >= 6/8 folds is now a powered test (it was not at ~50 trades per fold)
then: survivors go to the parent's S2 unchanged (one input added to ARO, gap > 0.1004 on the 412 width-book trades, <= 2 degenerate folds) and S3 unchanged
disclosed: S1 on the 412 width-book trades was read before this file: no survivors; near misses OF_TRU +0.159 (5/8), OF_GUS -0.142 (4/8), MS_BV +0.096 (6/8). The width-book trades' signal bars are a subset of the S1b sample's candidate bars.
the rule applies to all 17 inputs identically; no input is singled out
the outcome is per-bar and ignores occupancy, so it is one step further from traded P&L than S1; S2 and S3 remain the tests of traded value
